author: Kairos I
title: Multi-Epoch PPO with Spatial Attention LSTM
abstract: To improve sample efficiency, this experiment enhances the PPO algorithm by introducing multiple update epochs (4) per collected trajectory. This is applied to the SOTA CNNAttentionLSTM architecture to test if more thorough learning on each batch can break the 41.4 performance plateau. Uses the non-normalized PPO objective.

original_submission.content:
import sys
sys.path.append('storage/kairos')

import jax
import jax.numpy as jnp
from jax import vmap, jit, lax
import flax.linen as nn
import optax
from typing import Tuple, Dict, Any

# Import my proven SOTA architecture and GAE utility
from architectures import CNNAttentionLSTM
from ppo_utils import calculate_gae

def create_network(hparams):
    return CNNAttentionLSTM(
        lstm_features=hparams['lstm_features'],
        cnn_features_1=hparams['cnn_features_1'],
        cnn_features_2=hparams['cnn_features_2']
    )

# --- PPO Training Step with Multiple Epochs ---
def training_step(network: Any, optimizer: Any, params: Any, opt_state: Any, batch: Dict[str, jnp.ndarray], hparams: Dict[str, Any]) -> Tuple[Any, Any]:
    # This part is the same: prepare data and calculate advantages once
    observations, actions, rewards, dones, old_log_probs, old_values, final_values = (
        batch['observations'], batch['actions'], batch['rewards'], batch['dones'],
        batch['log_probs'], batch['values'], batch['final_values']
    )
    initial_rnn_states = batch.get('initial_rnn_states')
    advantages = calculate_gae(rewards, old_values, dones, gamma=0.97, gae_lambda=0.97, next_values=final_values)
    returns = advantages + old_values
    batch_size, trajectory_length = observations.shape[:2]

    # Define the loss function once
    def loss_fn(params_to_grad):
        # Forward pass logic is identical to previous PPO attempt
        if initial_rnn_states is not None:
            def process_env_trajectory(env_idx):
                env_rnn_state = jax.tree.map(lambda x: jax.lax.stop_gradient(x[env_idx]), initial_rnn_states)
                def step_fn(carry, t):
                    obs, prev_done = observations[env_idx, t], jnp.where(t > 0, dones[env_idx, t-1], False)
                    logits_b, value_b, new_rnn_state_b = network.apply(params_to_grad, obs[None, ...], prev_done[None, ...], jax.tree.map(lambda x: x[None, ...], carry) if carry is not None else None)
                    new_rnn_state = jax.tree.map(lambda x: x[0], new_rnn_state_b) if new_rnn_state_b is not None else None
                    return new_rnn_state, (logits_b[0], value_b[0])
                _, (env_logits, env_values) = lax.scan(step_fn, env_rnn_state, jnp.arange(trajectory_length))
                return env_logits, env_values
            all_logits, all_values = vmap(process_env_trajectory)(jnp.arange(batch_size))
        else:
            logits_flat, values_flat, _ = network.apply(params_to_grad, observations.reshape(-1, *observations.shape[2:]), dones.reshape(-1))
            all_logits, all_values = logits_flat.reshape(batch_size, trajectory_length, -1), values_flat.reshape(batch_size, trajectory_length)
        
        # PPO ratio and clipping logic (non-normalized)
        log_probs_all = jax.nn.log_softmax(all_logits, axis=-1)
        new_log_probs = log_probs_all[jnp.arange(batch_size)[:, None], jnp.arange(trajectory_length), actions]
        ratio = jnp.exp(new_log_probs - old_log_probs)
        
        adv_detached = jax.lax.stop_gradient(advantages)
        unclipped_obj = ratio * adv_detached
        clipped_obj = jnp.clip(ratio, 1.0 - 0.2, 1.0 + 0.2) * adv_detached
        policy_loss = -jnp.mean(jnp.minimum(unclipped_obj, clipped_obj))
        
        # Value and Entropy losses
        value_loss = 0.5 * jnp.mean((all_values - jax.lax.stop_gradient(returns)) ** 2)
        entropy = -jnp.mean(jnp.sum(jax.nn.softmax(all_logits, axis=-1) * log_probs_all, axis=-1))
        
        return policy_loss + hparams['value_loss_coef'] * value_loss - hparams['entropy_coef'] * entropy

    # --- Multi-Epoch Update Loop ---
    num_epochs = 4
    
    def update_epoch(i, carry):
        params_carry, opt_state_carry = carry
        grads = jax.grad(loss_fn)(params_carry)
        updates, new_opt_state = optimizer.update(grads, opt_state_carry, params_carry)
        new_params = optax.apply_updates(params_carry, updates)
        return (new_params, new_opt_state)

    # Run the update loop for num_epochs
    final_params, final_opt_state = lax.fori_loop(0, num_epochs, update_epoch, (params, opt_state))

    return final_params, final_opt_state
